title: How buy now, pay later benefits merchants
summary: Trade-press Q&A with a Stripe executive summarizes research on how offering BNPL increases merchant conversions and order value.

assertions.quote: the option leads to more purchases with bigger dollar values
across the board, from [the least expensive products] to [the most expensive], conversions went up when you offered BNPL
66% of BNPL volume came from net new transactions

verdicts.note: Stripe's own study found 66% net-new transactions for its merchant sample, but that vendor-linked finding may not generalize to the whole BNPL market.
NBER: 60-70% of BNPL's total sales effect at this merchant comes from the extensive margin (new conversions that would not have occurred otherwise), rather than existing buyers simply spending more.

assertions.quote: We've seen BNPL volume grow 172% in just the past year which really outpaces other payment methods

verdicts.note: Matches multiple independent growth-rate reports (Worldpay, CB Insights, Stripe) showing outsized BNPL volume growth versus other payment methods.
KC Fed cites Worldpay projecting BNPL's share of North American e-commerce value to roughly double (4% to 9%) and in-person value to double (1% to 2%) between 2021 and 2025.
CFPB: BNPL loan originations grew 970% and gross merchandise volume grew 1,092% from 2019 to 2021 among the five largest surveyed lenders.
